selection.selection_basis: metadata-frozen all-pairs session-1 EO/EC cohort; no feature or coordinate values used

methods.channel_order_check: exact BrainVision/BIDS label order is recorded; casefold-equivalent capitalization differences are warnings; different order/identity remains unsupported
methods.amplitude_and_peak_to_peak: continuous descriptors only; no amplitude threshold or automatic amplitude exclusion
methods.line_noise: median channel Welch PSD ratio 49-51 Hz / 1-45 Hz before the configured 50 Hz notch; descriptive only
methods.muscle_artifact: pilot's MNE-inspired filter/Hilbert score on an average-reference, 50/100/150 Hz-notched QC-only copy; 110-140 Hz; threshold >4; any-overlap with 8 s feature window rejects that window for primary summaries; no min_length_good gap merging; nonfinite source/detector or no active envelope channels makes the detector unassessed and windows ineligible
methods.artifact_correction: none; QC scores do not alter or reject feature signals
methods.adc_clipping: not assessed because BrainVision IEEE float samples do not declare verified ADC rails
methods.eog_ecg: not available in source BIDS metadata (0 EOG, 0 ECG channels)
methods.qc_flag_contract: NMD qc_ok_eeg remains unassessed unless the ingest artifact-QC pipeline is actually applied; this separate QC report does not set it
methods.raw_signal_hashes: not computed; BIDS/header sidecars are hashed

qualification: technical/QC description only; not evidence of artifact-free EEG or qualified external-anchor comparability
